paper_title: Few-shot Hate Speech Detection Based on the MindSpore Framework
caption: Ablation study on the HateXplain dataset. The line chart illustrates variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants on the HateXplain dataset. The x-axis is labeled "Model Variants" and has a categorical scale, listing five model variants: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)", has a linear scale, ranges from 58 to 66, and has a tick label interval of 2. The purple line representing precision starts at 65.56 for the full model, decreases to 61.06 for "w/o Prompt", increases to 63.7 for "w/o Augmentation", further increases to 64.06 for "w/o Attention", and reaches 65.44 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The blue line representing recall begins at 65.78, drops to 59.64, rises to 62.63, then declines to 59.17, and finally falls to 56.82. The brown line representing F1-score starts at 65.49, decreases to 60.16, increases to 62.22, drops to 59.67, and ends at 57.74.
